name: std::stacktrace_entry::stacktrace_entry
intro:
1) Default constructor. Creates an empty stacktrace_entry.

2) Copy constructor. Creates a copy of other.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
other

 -

  another stacktrace_entry to copy from

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: A non-empty stacktrace_entry can be obtained from a std::basic_stacktrace created by std::basic_stacktrace::current or a copy of such std::basic_stacktrace.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
